title: WeightCode: Installing New Capabilities into Neural Networks via Weight-Space Programming
read_level: full main text (Sec. 1-5) and appendix protocol A.1; other appendix sections skimmed
why_wsp: A frozen LLM (Claude Opus 5.5) writes executable weight programs p(W, I) that read a trained network's weights/activations and task knowledge and construct new weights without gradient training, installing new capabilities (SCAN primitives, BabyAI pickup, corruption robustness).
domain: compositional language (SCAN), navigation policy (BabyAI), image classification robustness (CIFAR-10-C, ImageNet-C)
editor: Claude Opus 5.5 at maximum reasoning effort
target: ViT-Lite-7/4 (3.7M weights), ResNet-20 (0.27M), ImageNet ResNet-18 (11.7M), CIFAR-10 ResNet-18 (11.2M), SCAN Transformers, BabyAI policy
interface: code/tensor tools (Python weight program, NumPy sandbox; statistics, SVD/PCA, closed-form fits, single-unit ablations)
loop: closed-loop with feedback (up to 8 candidate checks per session returning S_new/S_old counts; selection by retention rule)
fraction_or_count_of_weights_changed: "a program modifies 257 weights" (SCAN, Sec. 1); "from 3,846 modified weights for the ViT-Lite noise gate to 2,152,928 for the ImageNet noise correction (0.10% to 18%" (Sec. 4.1); sandbox cap "at most 20% of the weights" (App. A.1)

headline_results.quote: raises exact match on them from 0.0% to 99.8% by changing 257 weights, and the old commands do not change

headline_results.claim: Rule-to-data reference needs far more weights
headline_results.quote: trained on commands generated from the grammar, reaches 99.6% with 152,718 changed weights, about 594 times as many
the program raises pickup success from 0.0% to 98.4%, and the old mission moves by +0.4 points

headline_results.claim: ImageNet ResNet-18 net gains vs fine-tuning
headline_results.quote: The two programs written for Gaussian noise reach net gains of +10.47 and +17.62 points and the two written for contrast reduction +8.84 and +14.26, against +8.67 and +3.38 for the best of eight fine-tuning methods
Removing the block-2 gate lowers the net gain from +31.75 to +10.05, and removing all three gates returns the network to its original accuracy

headline_results.claim: Rerun vs copy on independent networks
headline_results.quote: each keeps 83% to 110% of its own gain on the held-out test sets
the edits of the ten programs gain −1.42 to +0.01 points on average
add +5.23 to +14.50 points of contrast robustness on the held-out test sets, while the installed noise robustness moves by −0.17 to +0.23

cost.quote: A session takes 30 to 130 minutes, and the CIFAR-10, SCAN and BabyAI sessions cost US$5 to 13 at API prices.
Rerunning a kept program on a further network takes a few minutes with no LLM call.

baselines_and_controls: Eight fine-tuning methods (full, last layer, LayerNorm/BatchNorm only, LoRA r4/r16, full without clean images, LwF, L2-SP) with matched examples, checks and retention rule; eleven fixed references incl. Tent, BN adaptation, SAR; behavior cloning (BabyAI); rule-to-data training (SCAN); gradient training of exactly the program-changed entries; LLM without weight values or outputs; copied edits and unit-aligned copied edits; random-unit gate variants.
runs_and_variance: ViT-Lite: "we ran ten sessions ... and report all of them" (Tab. 7); ImageNet ResNet-18: "two sessions per condition and report both"; reuse on five independently trained networks; 95% CIs on ImageNet.
robustness_of_edits: Transfer by rerun across five independently trained networks (83-110% of gain); effects on 25 corrupted test sets reported (changes no other set by more than 0.27 points for noise program); ImageNetV2 clean accuracy within 0.89 points; edits preserved through a second program round. Not tested under fine-tuning or quantization.
verification: none formal; causal interventions (gate removal, held-open gates); automatic audit plus manual reading of programs for protocol compliance; explicit rule reconstruction predicts BabyAI success/failure "on all 2,000 evaluated episodes"
memorization_vs_reasoning: Control: with parameter names, shapes, forward code and examples but no weight values or outputs, programs reach "+10.78 and +11.18" vs "+31.75 and +17.98" with weights (Sec. 4.2); gradient training of the same entries reaches only +3.60/+0.72.
limitations_stated: No dedicated limitations section; three exploratory sessions using finite differences separated out (App. A.11); programs reconnect existing representations, constructing representations a network does not yet have left to future work (App. A.10).
cites_or_builds_on: Takehi et al. 2026, Sparks of Weight-Space Programming (blog)
notes_for_survey: Defines the reusable 'weight program' as the artifact: rerunning the program on independently trained networks transfers gains while copying the numeric delta does not. Strong matched fine-tuning baselines and causal ablations of installed gates. Discussion frames WSP as a basis for 'self-directed capability extension' but no self-editing is performed.
